expected_behavior: An entity outside the first entity set stays visible in the graph as unsupported topology with a subsystem hint, and never becomes a supported activity or an implicit transport link. In the pilot this is the 3 ee-super-substation entities, classified as subsystem 'power', support 'unsupported', origin 'unknown'.
notes: This is a contract and adapter rule, not an engine mechanic; it is recorded here so the release gate covers it explicitly.

The dump used for the extract does define ee-super-substation, but no mod manifest identifies which mod and version supplied it, so its geometry is retained with origin 'unknown' and it stays unsupported.
observation_method: Static check rather than a game capture: the pilot coverage fixture lists every pilot entity name with its subsystem hint and support level.
title: Unsupported entities stay visible, never operating
